import collections
import dataclasses
import datetime
import enum
import hashlib
import json
import os
import tempfile
import time
import typing
import uuid


class Severity(enum.Enum):
    INFO = "INFO"
    LOW = "LOW"
    MEDIUM = "MEDIUM"
    HIGH = "HIGH"
    CRITICAL = "CRITICAL"


class EventType(enum.Enum):
    LOGIN_SUCCESS = "LOGIN_SUCCESS"
    LOGIN_FAILED = "LOGIN_FAILED"
    ACCESS_DENIED = "ACCESS_DENIED"
    PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION = "PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION"
    SUSPICIOUS_PROCESS = "SUSPICIOUS_PROCESS"
    PORT_SCAN = "PORT_SCAN"


@dataclasses.dataclass
class SecurityEvent:
    event_id: str
    timestamp: float
    event_type: str
    severity: str
    source_ip: str
    user: str
    details: typing.Dict[str, typing.Any]
    prev_hash: str = ""
    event_hash: str = ""

    def calculate_hash(self) -> str:
        payload = {
            "event_id": self.event_id,
            "timestamp": self.timestamp,
            "event_type": self.event_type,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "source_ip": self.source_ip,
            "user": self.user,
            "details": self.details,
            "prev_hash": self.prev_hash,
        }
        serialized = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True)
        return hashlib.sha256(serialized.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    def to_dict(self) -> typing.Dict[str, typing.Any]:
        return {
            "event_id": self.event_id,
            "timestamp": self.timestamp,
            "timestamp_iso": datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(
                self.timestamp, tz=datetime.timezone.utc
            ).isoformat(),
            "event_type": self.event_type,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "source_ip": self.source_ip,
            "user": self.user,
            "details": self.details,
            "prev_hash": self.prev_hash,
            "event_hash": self.event_hash,
        }


@dataclasses.dataclass
class SecurityAlert:
    alert_id: str
    rule_name: str
    severity: str
    timestamp: float
    description: str
    triggering_events: typing.List[str]

    def to_dict(self) -> typing.Dict[str, typing.Any]:
        return {
            "alert_id": self.alert_id,
            "rule_name": self.rule_name,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "timestamp": self.timestamp,
            "timestamp_iso": datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(
                self.timestamp, tz=datetime.timezone.utc
            ).isoformat(),
            "description": self.description,
            "triggering_events": self.triggering_events,
        }


class TamperEvidentAuditLogger:
    def __init__(self, log_filepath: str):
        self.log_filepath = log_filepath
        self.last_hash = "GENESIS_HASH"
        self._initialize_log()

    def _initialize_log(self) -> None:
        if os.path.exists(self.log_filepath) and os.path.getsize(self.log_filepath) > 0:
            with open(self.log_filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                last_line = None
                for line in f:
                    if line.strip():
                        last_line = line
                if last_line:
                    record = json.loads(last_line)
                    self.last_hash = record.get("event_hash", "GENESIS_HASH")
        else:
            open(self.log_filepath, "w", encoding="utf-8").close()

    def log(
        self,
        event_type: EventType,
        severity: Severity,
        source_ip: str,
        user: str,
        details: typing.Dict[str, typing.Any],
        timestamp: typing.Optional[float] = None,
    ) -> SecurityEvent:
        if timestamp is None:
            timestamp = time.time()

        event = SecurityEvent(
            event_id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
            timestamp=timestamp,
            event_type=event_type.value,
            severity=severity.value,
            source_ip=source_ip,
            user=user,
            details=details,
            prev_hash=self.last_hash,
        )
        event.event_hash = event.calculate_hash()
        self.last_hash = event.event_hash

        with open(self.log_filepath, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(event.to_dict()) + "\n")

        return event

    def verify_integrity(self) -> typing.Tuple[bool, typing.Optional[str]]:
        if not os.path.exists(self.log_filepath):
            return True, None

        expected_prev_hash = "GENESIS_HASH"
        line_num = 0

        with open(self.log_filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            for line in f:
                line_num += 1
                if not line.strip():
                    continue
                record_data = json.loads(line)
                recorded_hash = record_data.get("event_hash")
                prev_hash = record_data.get("prev_hash")

                if prev_hash != expected_prev_hash:
                    return False, f"Broken chain at line {line_num}: invalid prev_hash"

                event = SecurityEvent(
                    event_id=record_data["event_id"],
                    timestamp=record_data["timestamp"],
                    event_type=record_data["event_type"],
                    severity=record_data["severity"],
                    source_ip=record_data["source_ip"],
                    user=record_data["user"],
                    details=record_data["details"],
                    prev_hash=prev_hash,
                )

                if event.calculate_hash() != recorded_hash:
                    return False, f"Tampered payload detected at line {line_num}"

                expected_prev_hash = recorded_hash

        return True, None


class SecurityRule:
    def __init__(self, name: str, severity: Severity):
        self.name = name
        self.severity = severity

    def evaluate(self, events: typing.List[SecurityEvent]) -> typing.List[SecurityAlert]:
        raise NotImplementedError


class BruteForceLoginRule(SecurityRule):
    def __init__(self, threshold: int = 3, time_window_seconds: float = 60.0):
        super().__init__(name="Brute-Force Login Attempt", severity=Severity.HIGH)
        self.threshold = threshold
        self.time_window = time_window_seconds

    def evaluate(self, events: typing.List[SecurityEvent]) -> typing.List[SecurityAlert]:
        alerts: typing.List[SecurityAlert] = []
        user_failures: typing.Dict[typing.Tuple[str, str], typing.List[SecurityEvent]] = (
            collections.defaultdict(list)
        )

        for event in events:
            if event.event_type == EventType.LOGIN_FAILED.value:
                key = (event.source_ip, event.user)
                user_failures[key].append(event)

        for (source_ip, user), fail_events in user_failures.items():
            fail_events.sort(key=lambda e: e.timestamp)
            window: typing.List[SecurityEvent] = []
            for ev in fail_events:
                window.append(ev)
                window = [e for e in window if ev.timestamp - e.timestamp <= self.time_window]
                if len(window) >= self.threshold:
                    alert = SecurityAlert(
                        alert_id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
                        rule_name=self.name,
                        severity=self.severity.value,
                        timestamp=ev.timestamp,
                        description=(
                            f"Detected {len(window)} failed logins within "
                            f"{self.time_window}s for user '{user}' from IP '{source_ip}'."
                        ),
                        triggering_events=[e.event_id for e in window],
                    )
                    alerts.append(alert)
                    window.clear()
        return alerts


class CriticalAnomalyRule(SecurityRule):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(name="Immediate Critical Activity", severity=Severity.CRITICAL)

    def evaluate(self, events: typing.List[SecurityEvent]) -> typing.List[SecurityAlert]:
        alerts: typing.List[SecurityAlert] = []
        for event in events:
            if (
                event.severity == Severity.CRITICAL.value
                or event.event_type == EventType.PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION.value
            ):
                alert = SecurityAlert(
                    alert_id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
                    rule_name=self.name,
                    severity=self.severity.value,
                    timestamp=event.timestamp,
                    description=(
                        f"Critical security event observed: {event.event_type} "
                        f"by user '{event.user}' from '{event.source_ip}'."
                    ),
                    triggering_events=[event.event_id],
                )
                alerts.append(alert)
        return alerts


class SecurityMonitor:
    def __init__(self, logger: TamperEvidentAuditLogger):
        self.logger = logger
        self.rules: typing.List[SecurityRule] = []
        self.buffer: typing.List[SecurityEvent] = []
        self.alerts: typing.List[SecurityAlert] = []

    def add_rule(self, rule: SecurityRule) -> None:
        self.rules.append(rule)

    def ingest_event(
        self,
        event_type: EventType,
        severity: Severity,
        source_ip: str,
        user: str,
        details: typing.Dict[str, typing.Any],
        timestamp: typing.Optional[float] = None,
    ) -> SecurityEvent:
        event = self.logger.log(
            event_type=event_type,
            severity=severity,
            source_ip=source_ip,
            user=user,
            details=details,
            timestamp=timestamp,
        )
        self.buffer.append(event)
        self._analyze_buffer()
        return event

    def _analyze_buffer(self) -> None:
        for rule in self.rules:
            new_alerts = rule.evaluate(self.buffer)
            self.alerts.extend(new_alerts)

    def clear_buffer(self) -> None:
        self.buffer.clear()

    def get_alerts(self) -> typing.List[SecurityAlert]:
        return list(self.alerts)


def execute_security_demonstration() -> typing.Dict[str, typing.Any]:
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".log", delete=False) as tmp:
        log_path = tmp.name

    try:
        logger = TamperEvidentAuditLogger(log_path)
        monitor = SecurityMonitor(logger)

        monitor.add_rule(BruteForceLoginRule(threshold=3, time_window_seconds=30.0))
        monitor.add_rule(CriticalAnomalyRule())

        current_time = time.time()

        # Legitimate activity
        monitor.ingest_event(
            EventType.LOGIN_SUCCESS,
            Severity.INFO,
            "192.168.1.10",
            "alice",
            {"auth_method": "public_key"},
            timestamp=current_time,
        )

        # Brute force attack sequence
        attacker_ip = "203.0.113.42"
        for i in range(3):
            monitor.ingest_event(
                EventType.LOGIN_FAILED,
                Severity.MEDIUM,
                attacker_ip,
                "admin",
                {"attempt": i + 1, "service": "ssh"},
                timestamp=current_time + (i * 2),
            )

        # Critical escalation event
        monitor.ingest_event(
            EventType.PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION,
            Severity.CRITICAL,
            "192.168.1.50",
            "www-data",
            {"command": "sudo su", "target_uid": 0},
            timestamp=current_time + 10,
        )

        initial_integrity, initial_err = logger.verify_integrity()

        alerts_generated = [alert.to_dict() for alert in monitor.get_alerts()]

        # Simulate tampering
        with open(log_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            lines = f.readlines()

        if lines:
            tampered_record = json.loads(lines[0])
            tampered_record["user"] = "attacker_modified"
            lines[0] = json.dumps(tampered_record) + "\n"
            with open(log_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.writelines(lines)

        tampered_integrity, tampered_err = logger.verify_integrity()

        return {
            "initial_log_integrity": initial_integrity,
            "initial_log_error": initial_err,
            "tampered_log_integrity": tampered_integrity,
            "tampered_log_error": tampered_err,
            "total_alerts": len(alerts_generated),
            "alerts": alerts_generated,
        }
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(log_path):
            os.remove(log_path)

    results = execute_security_demonstration()
